problem.title: Shortest Path in a Directed Acyclic Graph
problem.problemStatement: Given a weighted Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and a source vertex S, determine the shortest distance from S to every other vertex.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N, M, and S. • Next M lines contain three integers u, v, and w.
problem.output: Print the shortest distance from S to every vertex. Print -1 for unreachable vertices.
